## Today's learning {#ss2-objective}

### Lesson objective

Understand the connections between sequence terms, partial sums and summation notation.

### Success criteria

I can evaluate and write sums using sigma notation and recover sequence terms from partial sums.

::: notes
This follows Section 2 of the booklet, printed pages 5–9. Students already know sequence notation and rules. Use the opening task as the connection to Lesson 1 rather than adding a separate prerequisite recap.
:::
